subject: math
question:
设 $A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & -2 & 2 \\ a & b & c \\ d & e & -2 \end{pmatrix}$ 与 $A = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & & \\ & 2 & \\ & & -7 \end{pmatrix}$ 相似，矩阵 $B^2 = BA$ 。记 $B = (\alpha_1, \alpha_2, \alpha_3)$ ， $B^{2023} =$

$(\beta_{1},\beta_{2},\beta_{3})$ ，将向量 $\beta_{1},\beta_{2},\beta_{3}$ 分别表示为 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 的线性组合.

steps.text:
分析 容易看出 $B^{2023}=B^{2022}A=\cdots=B A^{2022}$ ，故只需求出 $A^{2022}$ 。为此需先确定 A 中的待定常数，

并将 A 对角化.

因为 A 与 $\Lambda$ 相似，所以 $\operatorname{tr}A = \operatorname{tr}\Lambda$ ，即 $1 + b - 2 = 2 + 2 - 7$ ，所以 b = -2。

易看出 $\pmb{A}$ 的特征值为 $\lambda_{1} = \lambda_{2} = 2$ ， $\lambda_{3} = -7$ ， $A$ 与对角矩阵相似，必有 $\operatorname{rank}(2I - A) = 1$ .因此

$$
2 I - A = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 2 & - 2 \\ - a & 4 & - c \\ - d & - e & 4 \end{array} \right) \Rightarrow \left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac {- a}{1} = \frac {4}{2} = \frac {c}{2} \\ \frac {- d}{1} = \frac {- e}{2} = \frac {4}{- 2} \end{array} \Rightarrow a = - 2, c = 4, d = 2, e = 4. \right.
$$

解方程组 $(2I - A)X = 0$ ，得 $\lambda_{1} = \lambda_{2} = 2$ 对应的两个线性无关的特征向量：

$$
\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} = (2, 0, 1) ^ {\mathrm{T}}, \quad \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} = (- 2, 1, 0) ^ {\mathrm{T}}.
$$

正交化：令 $\beta_{1} = \alpha_{1},\beta_{2} = \alpha_{2} - \frac{(\alpha_{2},\beta_{1})}{(\beta_{1},\beta_{1})}\beta_{1} = (-2,1,0)^{\mathrm{T}} - \frac{-4}{5} (2,0,1)^{\mathrm{T}} = \left(-\frac{2}{5},1,\frac{4}{5}\right).$

单位化： $\gamma_{1} = \frac{\beta_{1}}{\|\beta_{1}\|} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} (2,0,1)^{\mathrm{T}},\gamma_{2} = \frac{\beta_{2}}{\|\beta_{2}\|} = \frac{1}{3\sqrt{5}} (-2,5,4)^{\mathrm{T}}.$

解方程组 $(-7I - A)X = 0$ ，得 $\lambda_{3} = -7$ 对应的特征向量为 $\alpha_{3} = (1,2, - 2)^{\mathrm{T}}$ .单位化得

$$
\gamma_ {3} = \frac {\alpha_ {3}}{\| \alpha_ {3} \|} = \frac {1}{3} (1, 2, - 2) ^ {T}.
$$

做正交矩阵 $P = (\gamma_{1},\gamma_{2},\gamma_{3})$ ，则有

$$
\boldsymbol {P} ^ {- 1} \boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {P} = \boldsymbol {\Lambda} \Rightarrow \boldsymbol {A} = \boldsymbol {P} \boldsymbol {\Lambda} \boldsymbol {P} ^ {\mathrm{T}}.
$$

因此

$$
\begin{array}{l} \boldsymbol {A} ^ {2 0 2 2} = \boldsymbol {P} \boldsymbol {\Lambda} ^ {2 0 2 2} \boldsymbol {P} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \\ = \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 / \sqrt {5} & - 2 / 3 \sqrt {5} & 1 / 3 \\ 0 & \sqrt {5} / 3 & 2 / 3 \\ 1 / \sqrt {5} & 4 / 3 \sqrt {5} & - 2 / 3 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 ^ {2 0 2 2} & & \\ & 2 ^ {2 0 2 2} & \\ & & 7 ^ {2 0 2 2} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 / \sqrt {5} & 0 & 1 / \sqrt {5} \\ - 2 / 3 \sqrt {5} & \sqrt {5} / 3 & 4 / 3 \sqrt {5} \\ 1 / 3 & 2 / 3 & - 2 / 3 \end{array} \right) \\ = \frac {1}{9} \left( \begin{array}{c c c} 2 ^ {2 0 2 5} + 7 ^ {2 0 2 2} & 2 \cdot 7 ^ {2 0 2 2} - 2 ^ {2 0 2 3} & 2 ^ {2 0 2 3} - 2 \cdot 7 ^ {2 0 2 2} \\ 2 \cdot 7 ^ {2 0 2 2} - 2 ^ {2 0 2 3} & 5 \cdot 2 ^ {2 0 2 2} + 4 \cdot 7 ^ {2 0 2 2} & 2 ^ {2 0 2 4} - 4 \cdot 7 ^ {2 0 2 2} \\ 2 ^ {2 0 2 3} - 2 \cdot 7 ^ {2 0 2 2} & 2 ^ {2 0 2 4} - 4 \cdot 7 ^ {2 0 2 2} & 5 \cdot 2 ^ {2 0 2 2} + 4 \cdot 7 ^ {2 0 2 2} \end{array} \right). \end{array}
$$

cdps.prompt: 对角化条件、相似变换还是重数关系？如何切入？
cdps.expected: 选定对角化或相似论证路径。

cdps.prompt: 对角化结论（可否对角化/P与对角阵）是什么？

meta.commentary:
评注 （1）题解中用到了结论：向量组 $A=(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{m})$ 可由向量组 $B=(\beta_{1},\beta_{2},\cdots,\beta_{s})$ 线性表示的充要条件是存在 $s\times m$ 阶的矩阵 C，使得 A=BC.

(2) 向量组正交化的施密特公式：设 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{m}$ 是 $R^{n}$ 中的一个线性无关的向量组，则向量组

$$
\dot {\beta} _ {1} = \alpha_ {1}, \quad \beta_ {2} = \alpha_ {2} - \frac {\left(\alpha_ {2} , \beta_ {1}\right)}{\left(\beta_ {1} , \beta_ {1}\right)} \beta_ {1}, \dots , \beta_ {m} = \alpha_ {m} - \frac {\left(\alpha_ {m} , \beta_ {1}\right)}{\left(\beta_ {1} , \beta_ {1}\right)} \beta_ {1} - \dots - \frac {\left(\alpha_ {m} , \beta_ {m - 1}\right)}{\left(\beta_ {m - 1} , \beta_ {m - 1}\right)} \beta_ {m - 1}
$$

是与 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{m}$ 等价的正交向量组.
